newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: Clashes erupt at Seoul's cathedral strike centre.
newsitem.headline: Clashes erupt at Seoul's cathedral strike centre.

text.p: Riot police fired volleys of teargas on Thursday to block thousands of workers from marching on Seoul's Myongdong Cathedral where seven labour leaders are sheltering from arrest.
Witnesses said the workers repeatedly tried to surge towards the cathedral but were repelled by stinging teargas.
The workers converged on a warren of narrow shopping alleys around the cathedral in central Seoul from protest rallies around the capital.
Riot police threw a tight cordon around the red-brick church. Squads of officers carrying clubs and shields were guarding all entrances.
On Wednesday some 15,000 workers clashed with police on the second day of a two-day strike called in protest at the passage of a new labour law that allows worker layoffs.
Workers have been angered by the arrest during the night of three union leaders and continued threats to seize the seven unionists in the cathedral.
